PrincipalAccountParty.name: Principal Account Party
PrincipalAccountParty.definition: Main party associated with the account.

SecondaryOwner.name: Secondary Owner
SecondaryOwner.definition: Entity that is not the primary owner when the ownership of the investment account is split among several owners.

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Ultimate party that is entitled to either receive the benefits of the ownership of a financial instrument, or to be paid/credited as a result of a transfer.

PowerOfAttorney.name: Power Of Attorney
PowerOfAttorney.definition: Entity that was given the authority by another entity to act on its behalf.

LegalGuardian.name: Legal Guardian
LegalGuardian.definition: Entity that has been appointed by a legal authority to act on behalf of a person judged to be incapacitated.

CustodianForMinor.name: Custodian For Minor
CustodianForMinor.definition: Entity that holds shares/units on behalf of a legal minor. Although the account is registered under the name of the minor, the custodian retains control of the account.

SuccessorOnDeath.name: Successor On Death
SuccessorOnDeath.definition: Deceased's estate, or successor, to whom the respective percentage of ownership will be transferred upon the death of one of the owners.

Administrator.name: Administrator
Administrator.definition: Entity that has been appointed by a legal authority to act on behalf of a person or organisation that has gone bankrupt.

Granter.name: Granter
Granter.definition: Granter role in the hedge funds industry.

Settlor.name: Settlor
Settlor.definition: Entity that creates a trust or contributes assets to the trust.

SeniorManagingOfficial.name: Senior Managing Official
SeniorManagingOfficial.definition: Party that makes, or participates in the making of, decisions that affect the whole, or a substantial part, of the business of a customer of a reporting entity or that has the capacity to affect significantly the financial standing of a customer of a reporting entity. Typically, this is a controlling person of a corporate (ownership type CORP).

Protector.name: Protector
Protector.definition: Person appointed under the trust instrument to direct or restrain the trustees in relation to their administration of the trust. Typically, this is a controlling person of a trust (ownership type TRUS) or other non-individual organisation (ownership type ONIS).

RegisteredShareholderName.name: Registered Shareholder Name
RegisteredShareholderName.definition: Party that registers its name with the issuer and the name used for the registration.
